# `apps/agent/binapi` — generated GoVPP bindings. DO NOT EDIT.

Generated by [`tools/binapi-gen.sh`](../../../tools/binapi-gen.sh) from the VPP **26.06** API definitions installed on the
dev host (`/usr/share/vpp/api/{core,plugins}/*.api.json`, 143 files) with GoVPP's `binapi-generator` (govpp **v0.13.0**,
the same version pinned in `go.mod`). One package per API file, import path `ngfw/agent/binapi/<api>` — e.g.
`ngfw/agent/binapi/interface` (Go package `interfaces`), `ngfw/agent/binapi/vpe`, `ngfw/agent/binapi/af_packet`.
`MANIFEST` lists every API file with its `vl_api_version` CRC.

**Ownership (D-014):** P04 generated it for *all* plugins present on the host; after P04 merges it belongs to the
**manager**, who reruns the generator when VPP on the host changes. Feature tasks never run the generator and never
hand-edit these files — a missing message means the VPP on the host does not have it: ask via
`docs/status/tasks/<id>-questions.md`. VPP API names come only from here (00-CONTEXT rule 6).

Regenerate: `tools/binapi-gen.sh` (idempotent — `git status --short apps/agent/binapi` is empty when nothing changed).
Usage: `vpe.NewServiceClient(conn).ShowVersion(ctx, &vpe.ShowVersion{})` — see `test/integration/smoke/`.
